title.zh: Ricursive自训65B模型：5人研发团队，编程能力逼近美国开源第一梯队
title.en: Ricursive自训65B模型：5人研发团队，编程能力逼近美国开源第一梯队

current_state.zh: Ex-DeepMind AlphaChip researchers' startup Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, an Apache-2.0 open-weights dense model with 1M-token context that scores 80.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, reportedly trained for $32M by a five-person team using efficiency techniques that cut required compute roughly 16x.
